meta.description: Builds and manages calibrated DIA spectral libraries through predicted, experimental, chromatogram, and format-conversion workflows, with RT/CCS calibration, NCE selection, decoys, QC, and full-key merge guidance.
meta.note: final pass: fixed and audited under one brief, see CHECKPOINT.md

scientific_integrity.detail: All synthetic calibration and similarity data were explicitly labelled; no citations, clinical claims, or invented empirical findings were presented.

practice_boundaries.detail: The Skill is limited to library construction and routes search, PTM design, and quantification to their owning Skills; it makes no individual diagnostic or treatment claim.

methodological_ground.detail: Fresh runs enforced RT calibration, compared NCE candidates, retained the full transition key, and generated an OpenSWATH decoy null.

code_usability.detail: All three shipped Python executables and the in-memory example were executed on the pinned source; live/local/OpenMS outputs were asserted.

functional_suitability.note: The Skill covers the promised predicted, empirical, calibration, conversion, QC, and merge routes with explicit ownership boundaries.

reliability.note: Major invalid-data and calibration failures have explicit guards; the live Koina route lacks bounded retry/backoff guidance for intermittent service latency.

performance_context.note: The 203-line SKILL.md delegates detailed method material to three targeted references and scripts.

agent_usability.note: Decision tree, required thresholds, failure modes, commands, and output checks are precise and internally consistent.

human_usability.note: Natural trigger phrases and a concise usage guide make the workflow discoverable while preserving strict scientific input checks.

security.note: No credentials, unsafe shell interpolation, destructive operation, or sensitive-data retention pattern was found.

maintainability.note: Long workflows are isolated in references and parameterized scripts; the shipped example exposes deterministic, checkable functions.

agent_specific.note: Trigger and routing boundaries are strong, with progressive disclosure and escape hatches; external-service retry policy is not yet explicit.

key_strengths: Every core route has a runnable, asserted result on the pinned source: live Koina, local DeepLC and MS2PIP, OpenMS conversion and decoys, merge/QC, and Spectronaut conversion.
The fixed OpenSWATH guidance accurately requires Annotation, real theoretical fragment m/z, and a unique transition_group_id, preventing both zero-decoy and silent-merge failures.
RT calibration and NCE guidance prevents two high-impact silent failure modes and is supported by quantitative guards.
The concise SKILL.md now uses focused references and executable scripts without losing decision-tree or safety boundaries.

recommendations.title: Add bounded Koina retry and timeout guidance
recommendations.problem: The live three-NCE scan completed, but individual Koina requests took about 61 seconds during this fresh run and the reference only re-raises server exceptions.
recommendations.root_cause: The Koina workflow validates peptides but has no explicit bounded retry, delay, or fallback instruction for transient service latency.
recommendations.fix: Add a short retry policy around Koina prediction: catch InferenceServerException, retry a bounded number of times with backoff, then stop with the model, server, and failed batch recorded.

recommendations.title: Use an explicit runtime check for iRT bounds
recommendations.problem: spectronaut_to_diann.py uses assert for the iRT-unit guard; Python optimization mode disables asserts.
recommendations.root_cause: The runtime validation was implemented as a development assertion rather than an unconditional ValueError.
recommendations.fix: Replace the assert with an if-not-between check that raises ValueError with the same message, preserving the tested failure behavior under python -O.
